macros.name: paragraph
macros.doc: The \section and \paragraph macros also accept a special syntax: If they are immediately followed by an exclamation mark (!), then they do not produce the corresponding decoration.

macros.name: phfeaDefineTheoremStyle
macros.doc: call \phfeaDefineTheoremStyle to redefine the theorem style after your customization.

macros.name: phfeaHeadingStyle
macros.doc: The macro \phfeaHeadingStyle is defined to be \sffamily, unless the sansstyle=false class option is provided in which case the macro expands to nothing.

macros.name: phfeaListsItemSep
macros.doc: For (non-inline) list environments such as itemize and enumerate, you can redefine \phfeaListsVerticalSkip, \phfeaListsItemSep, and \phfeaListsParSep to set the topsep, itemsep and parsep properties of all of enumitem’s list environments.

macros.name: phfeaListsParSep
macros.doc: For (non-inline) list environments such as itemize and enumerate, you can redefine \phfeaListsVerticalSkip, \phfeaListsItemSep, and \phfeaListsParSep to set the topsep, itemsep and parsep properties of all of enumitem’s list environments.

macros.name: phfeaListsVerticalSkip
macros.doc: For (non-inline) list environments such as itemize and enumerate, you can redefine \phfeaListsVerticalSkip, \phfeaListsItemSep, and \phfeaListsParSep to set the topsep, itemsep and parsep properties of all of enumitem’s list environments.

macros.name: phfeaParagraphDecorationSymbol
macros.doc: The default section and paragraph symbols (including size and vertical adjustments) are stored in the \phfeaSectionDecorationSymbol and \phfeaParagraphDecorationSymbol macros.

macros.name: phfeaParagraphStyle
macros.doc: The macros \phfeaSectionStyle and \phfeaParagraphStyle are used to set the style of the section and paragraph headings.

macros.name: phfeaSectionAfterHSkip
macros.doc: The macro (not length) \phfeaSectionAfterHSkip is the horizontal space between the end of the section heading and the beginning of the section text contents.

macros.name: phfeaSectionBeforeSkip
macros.doc: The macro \phfeaSectionBeforeSkip (it’s a macro, not a length) is used to specify the vertical spacing before a new section heading.

macros.name: phfeaSectionStyle
macros.doc: The macros \phfeaSectionStyle and \phfeaParagraphStyle are used to set the style of the section and paragraph headings.

macros.name: phfeaTitleStyle
macros.doc: The macro \phfeaTitleStyle sets the font style for the main document title.

envs.name: enumerate*
envs.doc: You also get a enumerate* environment that typesets its items in-line, in a single paragraph.
